title: The QCET Taxonomy of Standard Quality Criterion Names and Definitions for the Evaluation of NLP Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Included in the taxonomy as the 'Bias Inversion' quality criterion ([QIF-w-3]), which measures whether a system successfully inverts the political bias (e.g., left vs. right) of an input text. The methodology cited involves human evaluators assessing whether input/output pairs have fully or partially opposite political bias.
